azure-event-hubs-configuration.description: Azure Event Hubs credential and endpoint blocks. Referenced from receivers via azure-event-hubs-configuration-id.

id.description: Unique identifier (GUID) for this configuration block.

platform.description: Restrict this configuration to specific platforms.

send-data-url.description: Event Hubs data plane endpoint URL.

browser-web-app-url-component-detail-ent.description: Browser web app URL component detail configuration.

browser-web-app-url-filter-entry.description: Filter for browser web app metrics and SessionFgBrowserActiveTabHost. URLs can be allowed or denied.

citrix-adc-config.description: Citrix NetScaler / ADC configuration (Windows-only). One entry per ADC pair.

collect-adc-information-machines.description: Machine list for ADC information collection (when scope is MachineList).

collect-citrix-cloud-information-machine.description: Machine list for Citrix Cloud information collection.

config-cache-poll-interval.description: Interval at which the configuration cache is polled for changes.

config-change-restart-timeout.description: Delay before restarting the agent after a configuration change.

license-cache-poll-interval.description: Interval at which the license cache is polled for changes.

duration.description: A duration value. A unit suffix is required: 'w' (weeks), 'd' (days), 'h' (hours), 'm' (minutes), 's' (seconds), 'ms' (milliseconds), in strictly descending order and each unit used at most once. Compound durations like '4m20s' are supported. A bare integer is rejected because its meaning would depend on the field's native unit; the sole exception is 0, which is unit-independent. Examples: '30s', '5m', '2h', '500ms', '1d', '1w', '1w2d3h', 0.

event-data-filter.description: Per-sourcetype event-shaping filters. Each entry drops, allows, redacts, or defers events whose payload matches a uAQL query.

action.description: Filter action: allow, deny, clear, or defer.

field.description: Field name to clear. Required when action is 'clear'.

platform.description: Restrict this filter to specific platforms.

query.description: Optional uAQL query. When set, the action applies only to matching events.

sourcetypes.description: One or more sourcetypes this filter applies to.

event-log.description: Event log forwarding entries. Each entry configures platform-specific event log collection (Windows Event Log or macOS Unified Log).

channel.description: Windows Event Log channel to subscribe to, e.g. Security or Application.

event-filter-xpaths.description: Additional XPath filter expressions applied to the channel subscription.

event-ids.description: Restrict collection to these Windows event IDs.

levels.description: Restrict collection to events of these severity levels.

name.description: Event log name. Referenced from a timer's event-logs field.

platform.description: Platform this entry applies to. Selects the entry's key set: windows collects from the Windows Event Log, macos from the macOS Unified Log.

providers.description: Restrict collection to events from these Windows event providers.

max-message-length-bytes.description: Truncate collected log messages to this many bytes.

name.description: Event log name. Referenced from a timer's event-logs field.

platform.description: Platform this entry applies to. Selects the entry's key set: windows collects from the Windows Event Log, macos from the macOS Unified Log.

rate-limit.description: Maximum number of messages collected per interval.

event-trigger.description: Event triggers that can additionally trigger timers on specific events.

name.description: Event trigger name. Referenced by timers via the event-trigger field.

platform.description: Restrict this event trigger to specific platforms.

query.description: Optional uAQL filter query. The trigger fires only when the query matches.

types.description: Event types that fire this trigger.

enable-bypass-io.description: Allow Windows BypassIO for filesystem monitoring. When disabled, uberAgentFilter blocks BypassIO requests so that file events keep being reported. Applies to Windows only.

include-entry.description: Additional configuration files to include. Replaces the legacy @ConfigInclude directive.

path.description: Path to the configuration file to include.

platform.description: Restrict this include to specific platforms.

miscellaneous.description: General agent settings and implementation-defined flags.

browser-data-collection.description: Enable or disable data collection of uberAgent's browser extensions.

config-flags.description: Implementation-defined flags. Boolean flags default to false; parameterized flags are typed.

debug-mode.description: When enabled, uberAgent's log file is more verbose.

encrypt-user-names.description: Obfuscate user and domain names in the agent before sending.

license-file-path.description: Path to a directory where uberAgent searches for license files. Supports environment variable expansion.

log-file-count.description: Number of log files to keep (current + historical). When exceeded, the oldest log file is deleted.

register-ie-addon.description: Register or deregister uberAgent's Internet Explorer add-on through the service.

registry-monitoring.description: Enable registry monitoring. Requires ESA and Threat Detection Engine.

remote-thread-monitoring.description: Enable remote thread monitoring. Requires ESA and Threat Detection Engine.

telemetry-staging.description: Sends self-telemetry to the staging endpoint instead of production.

ignore-low-activity.description: Ignore processes with low network activity.

key.description: Process name or regex key for targeting.

network-driver-enabled.description: Enable network driver for this process.

test-compare-network-driver-and-etw.description: Compare network driver and ETW data (diagnostic).

nutanix-frame.description: Nutanix Frame virtual desktop integration settings.

frame-agent-detection-path.description: Path to the Frame agent detection file.

on-demand.description: On-demand metrics configuration. Metrics collected outside periodic timer intervals.

platform.description: Platform restriction. A single platform string or a list of platforms. Omit for all platforms.

process-detail-send-commandline-entry.description: Optionally add the command line to the ProcessDetail metrics. Use allow/deny lists to control which processes include command lines.

process-startup-duration-wait-interval-o.description: Override the default wait intervals for process startup duration measurement.

dll-load-wait-duration-global.description: Global DLL load wait duration override.

dll-load-wait-duration.description: DLL load wait duration for this process.

executable.description: Executable name for the per-process override.

process-startup-settings.description: Process startup monitoring and hashing settings (ESA).

authenticode-cache-max-size.description: Maximum entries in the Authenticode cache.

enable-blocked-execs.description: Detect blocked executable launches. Applies to macOS only.

enable-calculate-hash.description: Calculate file hashes for process images.

enable-cd-hash.description: Calculate code directory hashes. Applies to macOS only.

hash-algorithm.description: Hash algorithm for process image hashing.

hashes-cache-max-size.description: Maximum number of entries in the hash cache.

process-to-application-mapping-entry.description: Override uberAgent's automatic application identification. Each entry maps a regex pattern (matched against the full executable path) to an application name.

name.description: Application name to assign to matching processes.

regex.description: Regex pattern matched against the full executable path.

enable-esa.description: Enable the Endpoint Security Analytics (ESA) component. ESA requires UXM.

honor-environment-proxy.description: Honor proxy settings from environment variables (macOS/Linux).

proxy-credential.description: Proxy authentication credentials. Each entry maps a proxy endpoint to a credential (plaintext, XOR/Base64, or platform credential store reference).

credential.description: Proxy credential (plaintext, XOR/Base64, or credential store reference).

platform.description: Restrict this credential to specific platforms.

proxy.description: Proxy endpoint this credential applies to.

proxy-route.description: Proxy routing rules. Each entry maps a hostname regex to a proxy endpoint. Evaluated in declaration order; first match wins.

platform.description: Restrict this route to specific platforms.

receiver.description: Data receivers. uberAgent sends data to each configured receiver. Override per timer with the timer-level 'receivers' field.

azure-event-hubs-configuration-id.description: Reference to an azure-event-hubs-configurations entry by its id GUID.

enable-extended-info.description: Send extended event information to this receiver. Overrides the global process-startup-settings enable-extended-info for this receiver only.

etw-provider-guid.description: ETW provider GUID for the ETW receiver type.

host.description: Override the host field value sent to the receiver.

kafka-topic-name.description: Kafka topic name for the receiver.

max-queue-size-ram-mb.description: Maximum RAM queue size in megabytes.

name.description: A human-readable name for this receiver. Used to reference the receiver from timers.

persistent-output-queue.description: Persistent output queue settings for this receiver.

error-handling.description: Error handling strategy for the POQ.

max-age.description: Maximum age of events in the POQ before discard.

max-in-memory-bulk-operations.description: Maximum number of in-memory bulk operations for the POQ.

max-size-mb.description: Maximum size of the POQ in megabytes.

next-send-attempt.description: Delay before retrying a failed send operation.

servers.description: One or more server endpoints in host:port format. Use an array for failover or load distribution.

source.description: Override the source field value sent to the receiver.

tls-client-certificate.description: Path to TLS client certificate (PEM on macOS/Linux, thumbprint on Windows).

type.description: The backend this receiver sends to, including its network protocol where there is a choice. Splunk offers both, so pick splunk-tcp or splunk-http; every other backend has exactly one transport.

config-file-path.description: Path to the remote configuration file.

script-interpreter.description: Script interpreter definitions for Security & Compliance Inventory test execution. Each entry maps a name to an executable and an argv template.

args-template.description: Argument template. Use {script} as placeholder for the script path.

name.description: Interpreter name. Referenced from security-inventory-test entries.

script-context.description: Execution context. Windows: session-0-as-system, user-session-as-system, user-session-as-user. macOS and Linux: root, user.

session-fg-window-title-max-length.description: Maximum number of characters of the foreground window title to include in SessionDetail.

threat-detection-expression.description: Reusable named uAQL functions referenced from threat-detection-rules and other expressions (ESA only).

name.description: Expression name. Referenced from detection rules.

platform.description: Restrict this expression to specific platforms.

threat-detection-rule.description: Threat detection engine rules. Each entry is a uAQL-based detection over a specific event type (ESA only).

event-type.description: Primary event type this rule detects.

event-types.description: Additional event types (when a rule covers multiple types).

generic-properties.description: Additional properties to extract from matching events.

hive.description: Registry hive filter for registry-based detections.

platform.description: Restrict this rule to specific platforms.

risk-score.description: Numeric risk score (0–100) assigned to detections from this rule.

tag.description: Classification tag (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK technique ID).

verbose-logging.description: Enable verbose logging for this rule.

threat-detection-rule-extension.description: Per-rule overrides and exclusions for threat detection rules. Each entry targets a rule by id, event-type, or tag and refines its outcome (ESA only).

platform.description: Restrict this extension to specific platforms.

rule-id.description: Rule ID (GUID) of the rule to extend.

threat-detection-rule-filter-entry.description: Filter for threat detection rules. Allow or deny rules by regex pattern on rule name.

timer.description: Collection timers. Each timer wakes up periodically, computes configured metrics, and sends results to receivers.

event-logs.description: One or more event-log names to forward on this timer's schedule (overrides the default event log timer).

event-trigger.description: Name of an event-trigger that additionally fires this timer.

interval.description: Collection interval. Specifies how often the timer collects metrics.

name.description: Timer name. Must be unique across all timers.

perf-counters.description: One or more performance counter paths (Windows-only).

persist-interval.description: When true, the timer interval is persisted across agent restarts so that collections resume on schedule.

platform.description: Restrict this timer to specific platforms.

receivers.description: Override the default receiver list for this timer. Specify one or more receiver names.

script-context.description: Execution context for all scripts of this timer. Windows: session-0-as-system, user-session-as-system, user-session-as-user. macOS and Linux: root, user.

script-timeout.description: Maximum execution time before a script is terminated. Applies to all scripts of this timer.

scripts.description: Scripts to execute on each timer tick.

start-delay.description: Delay before the timer starts after agent launch.

ua-metrics.description: One or more uberAgent metric names to collect.
